purpose: Define formal bad-trace predicates and closure obligations for each public-seeded disaster-shape family in the taxonomy crosswalk. These packets are proof obligations plus bounded replay links; they are not universal immunity proofs until the coverage and rejection theorems are discharged.

global_theorem_template.class_closure: forall trace, BadTrace_C(trace) -> exists axis in Axes(C), Covers(axis, trace)
global_theorem_template.axis_rejection: forall trace axis, Covers(axis, trace) and AxisRejected(axis, trace) -> not AcceptedBadTrace(trace)
global_theorem_template.immunity: ClassClosure(C) and AxisRejection(C) -> forall trace, BadTrace_C(trace) -> not AcceptedBadTrace(trace)

bad_trace_predicate.name: EpochClockLifecycleSplitBrainBadTrace
conditions: trace contains an accepted action whose epoch, clock, or lifecycle source is not the unique current source of truth
the accepted action mutates price-dependent, settlement-dependent, or queue-dependent state
a neighboring stale, future, or fairness-incompatible view would be rejected by the declared guard

closure_obligations: Every accepted stale/future epoch trace maps to an epoch, oracle-window, lifecycle, or liveness axis.
Every mapped axis rejects the stale/future view or requires an explicit recovery/liveness certificate before mutation.

bad_trace_predicate.name: IdentityAuthorityCapabilityDriftBadTrace
conditions: trace contains an accepted action whose authorization material belongs to a different identity, role, session, nonce, or policy root
the accepted action crosses an execution, settlement, strategy, zUSD, or Tau witness boundary
the intended owner or capability-binding predicate would reject the same action under the canonical identity view

closure_obligations: Every identity-drift acceptance maps to a signer, nonce, capability, policy, session, or witness-binding axis.
Every mapped axis rejects neighboring identity material before live authority is granted.

bad_trace_predicate.name: CanonicalizationOrderingMevRouteBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a winner, ordering, netting pair, route, or repaired candidate outside the declared total key or certificate domain
a presentation-equivalent or feasible candidate would produce a different canonical winner or safer rejection
the accepted choice can change value allocation, MEV exposure, fill priority, or settlement semantics

closure_obligations: Every noncanonical acceptance maps to a route, batch, netting, candidate-domain, repaired-key, or Lean certificate axis.
Every mapped axis either proves winner equality under the total key or rejects ambiguous/repaired candidate drift.

bad_trace_predicate.name: SerializationSchemaWidthParserBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts serialized data whose parsed semantic value differs from the canonical schema value
the accepted parse crosses an operation, receipt, witness, state-accounting, or symbolic-guard boundary
a canonical decoder, width check, or wrapper parity check rejects the same payload

closure_obligations: Every parser/width confusion trace maps to a serialization, operations-envelope, state-size, wrapper, receipt, or symbolic-lint axis.
Every mapped axis rejects noncanonical encodings or proves adapter/parser parity for the accepted envelope.

bad_trace_predicate.name: ResourceExhaustionUnboundedSearchBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts caller-controlled or dependency-controlled bounds that exceed the declared resource envelope
the accepted path performs advisory, quote, proof, subprocess, or optimization work proportional to the hostile bound
the path can delay, abort, or starve normal steady-state behavior without a fail-closed budget result

closure_obligations: Every unbounded workload trace maps to a resource-budget, advisory-envelope, exact-out-domain, subprocess, or liveness axis.
Every mapped axis enforces a hard cap, load-shedding decision, timeout rejection, or explicit backlog status.

bad_trace_predicate.name: ExternalStateDependencyTransportBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts external state or transport output that is stale, oversized, malformed, unauthenticated, or root-mismatched
the accepted external value becomes authoritative for verification, settlement, strategy, or proof-state mutation
the dependency-outage or transport-boundary guard would reject the same value under canonical limits

closure_obligations: Every external-boundary bad trace maps to external-state, dependency, Tau client/runner, verifier, checker, import, or operator-environment axes.
Every mapped axis rejects malformed/outage/oversized drift or binds the external value to a checked root.

bad_trace_predicate.name: AtomicityReplayPersistenceRecoveryBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a replayed, partially applied, recovered, or persisted artifact as fresh and complete
the accepted artifact can duplicate a side effect, bypass a nonce/replay boundary, or mutate state under a stale root
the canonical replay, recovery, or receipt verifier rejects or requires a recovery certificate

closure_obligations: Every replay/partial-side-effect bad trace maps to atomicity, restart, nonce, proof-mining, sequence, witness, FIRE, or acceptance-TCB axes.
Every mapped axis rejects stale/replayed roots or requires the exact recovery certificate before acceptance.

bad_trace_predicate.name: NumericArithmeticRoundingIntegerBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts integer arithmetic whose rounded or bounded result lies outside the declared runtime/proof envelope
the accepted result mutates balances, reserves, accounting, oracle-dependent state, or curve-family value
a BVA, native-adapter, reference-parity, or proof-envelope check rejects the neighboring arithmetic case

closure_obligations: Every arithmetic mismatch maps to numeric-boundary, accounting, native-witness, oracle-BVA, ML-history, AMM, or canonical-math axes.
Every mapped axis rejects overflow/rounding drift or proves runtime/reference/proof envelope agreement.

bad_trace_predicate.name: OraclePriceProvenanceFreshnessBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts price-dependent mutation without a usable, fresh, positive, and provenance-bound oracle view
the accepted mutation affects settlement, perps, zUSD recovery, swap preflight, or benefit accounting
the oracle freshness/provenance guard rejects the stale, missing, or neighboring price root

closure_obligations: Every oracle freshness/provenance bad trace maps to zUSD, perps, funding clock, settlement price, LTL recovery, Tau semantic, or preflight axes.
Every mapped axis rejects missing/stale/unbound oracle material before price-dependent mutation.

bad_trace_predicate.name: ConfidentialAttestationPrivateBindingBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a confidential request, receipt, or verifier output bound to a neighboring private state
the accepted private state crosses admission, nonce, or verifier boundaries
the canonical confidential request or verifier binding check rejects the mismatched root

closure_obligations: Every confidential binding bad trace maps to confidential receipt, admission gate, core verifier, or nonce-state axes.
Every mapped axis rejects root drift before private evidence becomes authoritative.

bad_trace_predicate.name: SupplyChainProofArtifactReleaseBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a proof, receipt, generated artifact, release matrix, or toolchain output after its source root changed
the accepted artifact authorizes runtime, release, deployment, proof-mining, FIRE, Tau, or autotrader behavior
the corresponding root, receipt, falsifier, or ratchet check rejects the stale artifact

closure_obligations: Every proof/artifact drift trace maps to FIRE, Tau operator, autotrader, runtime shell, claims, RC1, ShapeForge, or ranking artifact axes.
Every mapped axis binds artifacts to current roots or rejects stale generated output.

bad_trace_predicate.name: SettlementWitnessCertificateRecomputeBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a settlement certificate, witness, or recompute result not bound to the current execution state
the accepted packet mutates balances, reserves, fills, or price-dependent settlement state
the end-to-end certificate, recompute, native witness, or lifecycle checker rejects the packet

closure_obligations: Every settlement certificate bad trace maps to recompute, quote gate, witness lifecycle, formal packet, native witness, price provenance, or queue axes.
Every mapped axis rejects state drift or proves packet/current-state binding before mutation.

bad_trace_predicate.name: MarketNamespaceCurveDispatchParityBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a market, curve, adapter, or reference value under a neighboring namespace or curve family
the accepted value changes quote, settlement, accounting, or curve-specific invariant semantics
the namespace, dispatch, reference-parity, or AMM-family check rejects the neighboring interpretation

closure_obligations: Every namespace/curve parity bad trace maps to market isolation, curve dispatch, core parity, refinement, zUSD accounting, split parity, or AMM parity axes.
Every mapped axis rejects aliasing or proves reference/runtime equivalence for the selected namespace.

bad_trace_predicate.name: FireTokenomicsRewardBudgetBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a reward, rebate, proof-mining, FIRE, tokenomics, or repair-economics spend above verified value plus explicit budget
the accepted spend mutates treasury, vault, proof-mining, tokenomics, or FIRE settlement state
the budget, package-root, slot-control, or repair-economics guard rejects the same spend

closure_obligations: Every reward/budget bad trace maps to vault reward, FIRE runtime, zUSD accounting, proof-mining slot, FIRE supply-chain, tokenomics wash, or repair-economics axes.
Every mapped axis rejects over-budget spend or binds it to verified value plus an explicit budget.

bad_trace_predicate.name: AutotraderKrrAiPolicyReasonerBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts AI/KRR/advisory output as live authority or accepts a signed policy/ranking/fact artifact under a stale root
the accepted artifact changes live strategy execution, wallet action, Tau witness, or policy compilation behavior
the advisory boundary, capability proof, fact-root, or signed-artifact guard rejects the same state

closure_obligations: Every AI/KRR policy bad trace maps to advisory cache, autotrader artifact, signing, KRR, native strategy, Tau witness, semantic gate, chaos regret, import, solver-policy, or ranking axes.
Every mapped axis preserves advisory non-authority or rejects stale fact/policy roots.

bad_trace_predicate.name: StablecoinVaultSupportRecoveryBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a zUSD vault/support/recovery action under a stale oracle, wrong selector, or neighboring support root
the accepted action mutates debt, collateral, liquidation, redemption, or recovery state
the zUSD oracle, API token, accounting, LTL recovery, or support selector guard rejects the same state

closure_obligations: Every stablecoin recovery bad trace maps to zUSD oracle, API token, native accounting, LTL recovery, or support selector axes.
Every mapped axis rejects stale oracle/support roots or proves selector/accounting consistency.

bad_trace_predicate.name: GeneralChaosSteadyStateRepairBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a perturbation that increases disaster potential or disrupts steady-state behavior
the accepted perturbation lacks the exact recovery certificate required for the risk increase
the disaster-potential, chaos-regret, dependency, or shape-ratchet check rejects the same perturbation

closure_obligations: Every chaos/recovery bad trace maps to repair, outage, load-shedding, concolic wrapper, runner lifecycle, TLA queue, acceptance-TCB, chaos regret, operator, or ShapeForge axes.
Every mapped axis rejects risk-increasing transitions unless the required recovery certificate is present.

bad_trace_predicate.name: SealedBidBountyCatalogFeedbackBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a sealed-bid, bounty, or catalog feedback state after commitment, reveal, or candidate-index substitution
the accepted state changes candidate eligibility, bounty allocation, or commitment semantics
the commitment-binding or catalog feedback checker rejects the substituted state

closure_obligations: Every sealed-bid/bounty bad trace maps to commitment-binding or stateful catalog feedback axes.
Every mapped axis rejects substituted commitments, reveals, or omitted/promoted candidates.

bad_trace_predicate.name: CrossSurfaceCompositionFormalBridgeBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts two locally valid proof, runtime, or policy surfaces whose composition violates a global invariant
the accepted composition mutates settlement, FIRE, exact-out, repair, autotrader, or cross-venue state
the formal packet, Morph/Shapeforge bridge, or cross-surface proof rejects the composed state

closure_obligations: Every cross-surface bad trace maps to Cantor/Shapeforge, formal packet, FIRE runtime, repair-economics, autotrader-policy, or cross-composition axes.
Every mapped axis rejects composition drift or proves the shared invariant across surfaces.

bad_trace_predicate.name: PerpsLiquidationFundingLegacyReferenceBadTrace
conditions: trace accepts a perps settlement, funding, liquidation, legacy reference, or submission path under stale oracle or arithmetic drift
the accepted path mutates collateral, PnL, funding, insurance, liquidation, or market parameters
the perps oracle, BVA, submission, legacy-ref, or funding/liquidation guard rejects the same trace

closure_obligations: Every perps bad trace maps to funding/liquidation, submission, oracle parity, legacy-ref, integration bootstrap, or native-adapter BVA axes.
Every mapped axis rejects unusable oracle/arithmetic/reference drift before perps state mutation.
